messages:
zoe: Found a confusing flow: paste param {"name":"zip"} in schema editor -> save -> banner says "Schema invalid" but nothing points to the param.

sam: That's consistent with validate-on-save approach. Pasting without type is the common case.

zoe: Can we do a small, debounced lint on the edited node and show an inline error icon + tooltip that focuses the field?

kai: Yes — 600ms debounce, validate subtree only, surface inline icon button with aria-label and keep banner for fatal errors.

aisha: Accessibility: the banner needs a role=alert announcement with node path and a focusable "Jump to error". Suggested announcement: "Schema error in parameter 'zip': missing type. Press Enter to jump." Use aria-live assertive only when error appears.

sam: For run history, instead of raw blobs show compact preview row (first 3 keys + types) and a keyboard-toggle to expand the full tree (aria-expanded + lazy fetch).

zoe: Also check contrast for the inline icon; current red is low contrast at small sizes.

design-bot: Created tickets: "playground: inline-lint + jump", "run-history: compact-preview" assigned to @sam and @kai.

sam: I'll mock the inline icon and the run-history preview by tomorrow.

kai: I'll prototype debounce + aria behavior and coordinate a11y testing.

aisha: I'll run VoiceOver + keyboard passes when ready.
